fields.name: site_name
fields.description: {"value":"Name of the air quality monitoring site.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: county_name
fields.description: {"value":"County name where the monitoring site is located.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: dv_year
fields.description: {"value":"Design value year used for the ozone statistic.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: dv
fields.description: {"value":"The level of the 2015 8-hour ozone NAAQS is 0.070 parts per million (ppm). The design value is the 3-year average of the annual 4th highest daily maximum 8-hour ozone concentration. Monitors with design values less than or equal to 0.070 ppm must have 75% annual data capture and 90% 3-year average data capture in order to be considered valid.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: valid
fields.description: {"value":"Indicates whether the design value is valid for comparison to the NAAQS.","fieldValueType":"binary"}

fields.name: AQSID
fields.description: {"value":"EPA AQS site identification code for the monitoring station.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: naa_name
fields.description: {"value":"Nonattainment area name associated with the site, if applicable.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}
